description:
Search TraderMatrix's own guides and glossary (how each tool works, what a
term means, how to read a screen). Use this when the user asks how a TraderMatrix
tool works, what a trading or options term means, or which page covers a topic.
Returns the best matches with a short snippet, a markdownUrl, and toolUrl, the live
tool page to hand the user. Call get_learn_page for the full guide.

query.description: What to look up, e.g. 'how does the heat map work' or 'new money'

name: search_learn
title: Search TraderMatrix Learn Docs
